name.zh: 暖红等轴测方块信息图

style_profile.scope: 作品级风格档案，依据会话中的动物生物量参考图。适用于分组、图鉴、规模比较及过程类编辑信息图。定量几何须按数据核验；定性或顺序信息使用等体量层。

references.source: 会话中提供的 Biomass of Life 海报，原图与出处未在仓库归档。以下证据为会话逐图观察记录。

roles.scope: 纸面、体素组织、光色、排版、微雕与标注。

evidence.description: 立式纸面上有一条集中的分层三维堆栈，两旁留出注释区域。
同一体块左侧较暗、右侧较亮。最上层偏深红，最低层偏浅杏。
细折线和小端点连接数据层与对侧标签，标签先显示色块数值。
黑色高对比标题与灰色引题分层，右侧短块文字有红色竖线，纸底近暖白。
动物微雕附在层边，与承载体块同色系，占局部空间。
图例定义每个单位立方体，类别值随堆栈高度向下递减。

layer_subjects.zh: 各层对应的小型对象标记。
layer_subjects.en: Small objects that identify the layers.

allowed_changes.zh: 层数、具体承载物、层间距离。
allowed_changes.en: Layer count, objects and gap sizes.

instruction.zh: 以等轴测方块网格形成中央纵向爆炸堆栈，层层悬浮，两侧留出稳定的标注空间。
instruction.en: Build a central exploded vertical stack from isometric voxel blocks and reserve both side gutters for callouts.

check.zh: 缩略图可读出中央堆栈、分层间隙与两侧标注区。
check.en: Verify the central stack, gaps and callout gutters at thumbnail size.

allowed_changes.zh: 过渡步数、局部色相和光源强度。
allowed_changes.en: Number of tonal steps, local hues and light intensity.

instruction.zh: 沿堆栈由深氧化红和砖红过渡至陶橙与浅杏；统一斜光让左侧较暗、右侧较亮。
instruction.en: Run a deep oxide-red to brick-red, terracotta and pale-apricot progression down the stack. Use consistent angled light with darker left and lighter right faces.

check.zh: 检查明暗方向、色阶顺序与浅色层的边界。
check.en: Check light direction, color progression and pale-layer boundaries.

allowed_changes.zh: 标注起始侧、标签长度和次要说明。
allowed_changes.en: Starting side, label length and optional notes.

instruction.zh: 把短标签分布在两侧，用细折线和小端点一一连接本层，避免交叉或误指。
instruction.en: Distribute short labels across the side gutters. Use thin elbow leaders and small endpoints to connect each label to its own layer without crossing.

check.zh: 逐条追踪标签与层关系。
check.en: Trace each label to its intended layer.

instruction.zh: 以暖白细纸纹支撑黑色高对比衬线标题、低对比引题和短锈红竖线。
instruction.en: Set a high-contrast black serif headline, subdued kicker and short rust-red rule on subtly textured warm-white paper.

check.zh: 标题先读，纸纹与引题保持从属。
check.en: Verify that the headline reads first and the kicker and paper texture remain subordinate.

instruction.zh: 将{{layer_subjects}}处理为层边的同色系小型立体物件，局部精细，保持方块网格清晰。
instruction.en: Render {{layer_subjects}} as small tonal sculptures at the block edges. Keep fine detail local and preserve the legibility of the voxel grid.

check.zh: 逐层查看物件可读性以及是否遮蔽网格。
check.en: Check each object for legibility and verify it does not obscure the voxel grid.

condition.zh: 任务明确提供可比较的定量体积数值与单位。
condition.en: The task supplies comparable quantitative volumes and units.

allowed_changes.zh: 度量对象、正确单位、分组数量。
allowed_changes.en: Measured subject, correct unit and group count.

instruction.zh: 按已核实的单位计算各层几何体积，标明单位与图例，并逐项核对数值对应。
instruction.en: Compute each layer’s geometry from the verified unit. Include that unit in the legend and verify every value against its module.

check.zh: 核对单元数、体积、值和图例；缺少数据时保留未知。
check.en: Verify cube counts, volumes, values and the legend. Mark unavailable data as unknown.
